snippet.title: H.A.I.N - Official Gameplay Trailer [ Indie-Credible Showcase 2026 ]
snippet.description:
H.A.I.N: Heir of the Ancient Immortal Necromancer is an asymmetrical co-op horror/thriller game for 1-4 players. Explore hostile regions, collect ancient artifacts, and begin the final ritual. But one of you will become H.A.I.N, the betrayer, and trust will collapse.

Official Steampage:

https://store.steampowered.com/app/3351260/HAIN/

This trailer is part of the Indie-Credible - Indie Game Showcase 2026:

https://indie-credible.com
